street_pool.query: one estimate per OTHER lot on the frontage street (parcels.primary_frontage_street_name = the subject's, M-424), within 200 m (polygon distance), the subject and its abutters excluded, est_status estimated: with est as (select neighbour_id id, avg(front_setback_est_m) v from parcel_abutments where est_status='estimated' group by 1), s as (select id, geom, primary_frontage_street_name fs from parcels where id=410720) select json_agg(round(e.v,2) order by e.v) from parcels p cross join s join est e on e.id=p.id where p.id<>s.id and p.primary_frontage_street_name=s.fs and ST_DWithin(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography,200) and not exists (select 1 from parcel_abutments x where x.parcel_id=s.id and x.neighbour_id=p.id)
